en-US.name: Patent Disclosure Skills
en-US.summary: Collection of Chinese patent skills for disclosure, search, reading, mapping and office-action assistance. MIT licensed. Legal or filing work still needs a qualified professional; optional Python tools and a vendored mermaid.min.js over 1 MiB are included under skills/.
en-US.description: Pinned at 491524bd36a3f9f8d2e35caa5b56368b67d88ced. Collection children are the nine skills under skills/. A root SKILL.md umbrella document exists but is not a collection child. Two docs images also exceed 1 MiB. This is a different work from the already listed cnipa-patent-search skill.

zh-CN.name: 专利交底技能
zh-CN.summary: 中文专利技能合集，用于交底、检索、阅读、专利地图和审查意见辅助。许可为 MIT。法律或申请事务仍需具备资质的专业人员；skills/ 下含可选 Python 工具，以及一个超过 1 MiB 的 vendored mermaid.min.js。
zh-CN.description: 固定版本 491524bd36a3f9f8d2e35caa5b56368b67d88ced。合集子项是 skills/ 下的九个技能。根目录另有 SKILL.md 总述，不是合集子项。docs 中还有两张超过 1 MiB 的图。这与已上架的 cnipa-patent-search 不是同一作品。

requirements.value: Optional scripts use Python and packages listed in requirements.txt. skills/patent-disclosure/tools/vendor/mermaid.min.js is about 2.45 MiB.
This skill assists drafting and research; it is not legal advice and does not file applications. Confirm sources and have a qualified professional review any filing.

en-US.name: patent-application
en-US.summary: 申请文件：把已有交底写成权利要求书、说明书、摘要与说明书附图；规划发明母案与分案并核对原始披露。四件套须指定交底目录。内容争议写入问题清单，交付后请确认须摘要清单。已有产出上改稿则另存新时间戳目录。须显式触发。

en-US.name: patent-chart
en-US.summary: 权利要求对照表：独权拆成技术特征，逐格比对对比文件/产品/标准，附证据与强弱。用于无效对照、FTO 初筛、侵权/EoU、SEP、可专利性底稿。须点名。不出法律意见。

en-US.name: patent-docket
en-US.summary: 按发明人/工程师给的材料一趟写出交底书和申请文件；申请问题清单上的缺口最多改三轮。缺技术事实就问人，不编。触发：交底申请一起做、从零出交底和申请、一条龙、帮写交底再出申请、按清单改、会稿、案卷、/patent-docket。

en-US.summary: 专利著录检索：中国专利公布公告（发明人、申请人、分类号、名称、摘要；也可从单图或权利要求生成名称/摘要关键字后查询）；用户点名海外时，用 Google Patents 检索美欧日韩等海外专利。
